implemented.rows: Before native serialization/copy, reserve lookup array and owned JSON output. Retained rows keep their actual text owner; duplicate lookup output releases immediately. Map capacity grows before insertion; row/member copies reserve before original spread/map, roll back failed insertion, and retain across frames. Existing 4096-row limit remains. Preview construction rollback disposes its rows/keys; completed preview disposal releases them.

declaredCapacities.membership: 32 array header + 104 per member (96 member record + 8 array slot)
declaredCapacities.nesting: 32 stack header + 104 per active span (96 record + 8 slot)
declaredCapacities.snapshot: 512 base + 768 per row + 160 per member. Per-row allowance includes copied row/member-array header, two row-array slots, worst-case unique type record/Map slot/key-owner slot/output-type slot/JSON input array and original kinds-array/Set headers. Per-member allowance includes 96 copied record + 8 member slot + 16 kinds-array slots + 40 worst-case Set entry. Owned serialized type keys are admitted separately and released after aggregation.
declaredCapacities.strings: 128 text control + two bytes per completed UTF16 code unit; conservative temporary output/sort capacity remains admitted through serialization.

implemented.lifetime: Snapshot copies are independent owned containers and survive row/preview disposal. Both actual pinned backends return their owned snapshot through real Playwright page RPC; a separate caller acknowledgement disposes the page allocator and clears both snapshot arrays. Node retains its deserialized complete counters after actual page copies are cleared. This is native lifetime coverage, not production RPC/Node admission.
implemented.measurementCanvas: Native proof found the WebGL preview measurement Canvas still retained its default 300x150 backing after disposal. Release it after original coverage/text preparation, including preparation failure, and on unavailable-context failure. Native post-preview pixel admission is now zero on both backends. Original generic/native text and public decoded frame checks remain exact.
implemented.errors: Quota denial precedes native submission/snapshot copying; original null member-copy/submission errors survive cleanup even after allocator disposal. Factory denial precedes invocation, duplicate adoption preserves the borrowed original owner, and a fresh factory result after disposal is destroyed while preserving the original ownership error.
implemented.scope: Declared selected statistics container/key/member/snapshot capacity. Ledger/control/private VM storage, remaining renderer/cache/font metadata, Node protocol/result copies and complete production/aggregate admission remain pending. Native codec/driver/VM/private RSS are separate; no 8GiB or speed acceptance claimed.
